newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 9.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Wednesday:
* NATO extended invitations to three former adversaries - Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary - to join the alliance.
* The Clinton Administration said the proposed tobacco settlement would dilute the Food and Drug Administration's authority to regulate nicotine.
* The Senate committee investigating campaign finances began hearings with the chairman saying there was a sinister plot by the Chinese government to influence American elections.

* The New York Democratic party is mired in its deepest rut in a generation, with many Democrats saying they'll vote for a Republican for New York City mayor this year and a Republican for governor next year.
* In Cambodia, forces loyal to the Second Prime Minister, Hun Sen, began hunting down and killing his political opponents, raising the specter of civil war.
* Doctors said that a very rare heart ailment had appeared in 24 women who took a popular diet pill combination.
